paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : LLaMA-2-7B
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the effectiveness of a model with and without an extension across a range of input lengths. The horizontal axis is labeled "text length" and spans linearly from 0 to 4, with tick labels at integer values. The vertical axis is labeled "informativeness" and spans linearly from 0.920 to 0.960. A blue dashed line, labeled "w.o. extension," begins at 0.958 at text length 0 and decreases to 0.921 at text length 4. An orange solid line, labeled "extension," begins at 0.960 at text length 0 and decreases to 0.922 at text length 4.
